title: CC3220S LaunchPad (CC3220S-LAUNCHXL rev A) - top (raptox's board, 2026-11-05)

callouts.label: SOP jumpers (SOP2/SOP1/SOP0)
callouts.note: 'J13', 'SOP' and the row numbers 2/1/0 are printed beside the 2x3 header; a jumper sits on one row (which one: check on the board, the photo is too soft to say).

callouts.label: CC3220S
callouts.note: Marking legible: 'CC3220S / M2 / TI 65I / A809 G4'. The LaunchPad's own CC3220S, same part family as U1 on the cooker's main board.

callouts.label: Serial flash (MX25R3235F, 4 MiB)
callouts.note: SOIC-8 above U7, 'U8' printed beside it. The marking reads 'MXIC 25R3235F' only partly in the photo, so the part is by the LaunchPad's design, not the marking.

callouts.label: Micro-USB to the XDS110 debug probe
callouts.note: The board's only USB port, at the right edge beside L2/U2 and the XDS110's TM4C129 MCU. Its reference designator is not legible in the photo.

callouts.label: Reset button SW1
callouts.note: 'RESET' and 'SW1' are printed beside it; side-actuated tactile switch at the right board edge.

callouts.label: BoosterPack headers (2 x 20 pins)
callouts.note: The two 2x10 header rows at the top and bottom edges, pin names printed beside them (P02, P01, P62 ...). The J1-J4 designators themselves are not legible in the photo.
